About our brand and products:
Called & Marked Co. creates personalized, faith-filled keepsakes that celebrate the identity, purpose, and God-given value of children. Our collection includes personalized pillows, blankets, canvases, framed posters, and premium framed canvases for nurseries, birthdays, baby showers, baptisms, dedications, and other meaningful family occasions.

What makes us different:
Each keepsake is thoughtfully personalized with details such as the child’s name, name meaning, photograph, special phrase, and Bible verse. Our products combine meaningful Christian encouragement with beautiful, gift-ready designs families can treasure.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn $5 for every eligible pillow or blanket sold, $7 for every eligible canvas or framed poster, and $10 for every eligible framed canvas sold through their tracked affiliate link or approved coupon code.

How to promote us:
Share Called & Marked Co. through authentic product recommendations, gift guides, unboxings, nursery inspiration, baby-shower ideas, newborn and birthday content, Christian family content, social-media posts, blogs, videos, and email newsletters.

Other information:
We welcome family, parenting, motherhood, Christian lifestyle, gifting, nursery décor, newborn, photography, and baby-shower creators. Applications are reviewed manually. Affiliates receive a 30-day tracking period, with approved commissions paid monthly after reaching the $25 minimum payout threshold.
payout_period: Paid monthly with a $25 minimum. Balances under $25 roll over to the next month. Commissions are paid only after orders are validated and may be reversed for cancellations, refunds, disputes, or chargebacks.

CALLED & MARKED CO. AFFILIATE PROGRAM

TERMS AND CONDITIONS

Effective Date: August 14, 2026

These Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions (“Terms”) govern participation in the Called & Marked Co. Affiliate Program (“Program”).

“Called & Marked Co.,” “Company,” “we,” “us,” and “our” refer to the merchant operating the Program. “Affiliate,” “you,” and “your” refer to the individual or business applying for or participating in the Program.

By submitting an application, accessing the affiliate dashboard, using an Affiliate Link or Affiliate Coupon, or otherwise participating in the Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms.

If you do not agree to these Terms in their entirety, you may not apply for or participate in the Program.

1. Eligibility

To participate in the Program, you must:

  1. Be at least 18 years old and legally capable of entering into a binding agreement;

  2. Provide complete and accurate registration, contact, tax, and payment information;

  3. Maintain an active website, social-media account, email list, or other marketing channel that we consider appropriate for the Program;

  4. Comply with these Terms, all applicable laws, and the rules of every platform you use; and

  5. Reside in or operate from a country where participation in an affiliate program and receipt of affiliate payments are legally permitted.

Employees of Called & Marked Co. may not participate unless expressly approved in writing.

2. Application Approval or Rejection

All applications are subject to review and approval.

We reserve the right to approve or reject any application in our sole discretion, including applications from websites or accounts containing content that we consider unlawful, deceptive, misleading, offensive, discriminatory, sexually explicit, violent, infringing, harmful, or inconsistent with our brand and values.

Submitting an application does not guarantee acceptance into the Program. Applicants will have no claim against Called & Marked Co. based on the approval or rejection of an application.

We may request additional information before making an approval decision.

3. Affiliate Relationship

Participation in the Program does not create an employment, agency, partnership, franchise, joint-venture, fiduciary, or sales-representative relationship between you and Called & Marked Co.

You are an independent contractor responsible for deciding how, when, and where you promote approved products, subject to these Terms.

You do not have authority to:

  • Enter into an agreement on behalf of Called & Marked Co.;

  • Make promises, warranties, guarantees, or representations on our behalf;

  • Create obligations or liabilities for Called & Marked Co.;

  • Represent that you are an employee, agent, or official representative of Called & Marked Co.; or

  • Speak on behalf of Called & Marked Co. without prior written authorization.

4. Affiliate Links and Coupons

After approval, you may receive a unique tracking link (“Affiliate Link”) and, when applicable, an approved coupon code (“Affiliate Coupon”).

Affiliate Links may direct customers to our website, a specific product, or an approved collection. You may only use links, coupons, and promotional materials authorized through the Program or provided by Called & Marked Co.

An Affiliate Coupon is not guaranteed. If you have not been assigned a branded or personalized Affiliate Coupon, you may not create, advertise, or distribute one that implies affiliation with Called & Marked Co.

Affiliate Links and Affiliate Coupons may not be altered, concealed, redirected, or manipulated in a manner that interferes with accurate tracking or misleads customers.

Using an Affiliate Link and an Affiliate Coupon on the same transaction will not generate two commissions. Only one commission may be earned per eligible order.

5. Tracking and Attribution

The Program currently uses a 30-day tracking-cookie period.

When a potential customer clicks an Affiliate Link, a tracking cookie may be placed on the customer’s device. An eligible purchase completed within 30 days of the qualifying click may be attributed to the Affiliate, subject to these Terms and the Program’s tracking system.

The Program generally uses last-click attribution. If a customer clicks another Affiliate’s qualifying link after clicking your link, the order may be attributed to the most recent qualifying Affiliate Link.

Affiliate tracking depends on technology and customer settings. Called & Marked Co. cannot guarantee attribution when:

  • The customer blocks or rejects cookies;

  • The customer deletes cookies;

  • The customer changes browsers or devices;

  • A browser, application, privacy service, or security program prevents tracking;

  • The Affiliate Link is altered, broken, or used incorrectly;

  • The customer uses another Affiliate’s link after using yours;

  • The purchase occurs after the 30-day tracking period;

  • The customer completes the purchase through a channel that does not support affiliate tracking; or

  • Another technical or attribution issue prevents the order from being connected to your account.

Called & Marked Co. will not manually assign commissions based solely on screenshots, customer statements, or claims that an Affiliate Link was previously used when the Program’s records do not show qualifying attribution.

Our tracking records and reasonable determination regarding attribution will control, except in cases of an identifiable technical or administrative error.

6. Commission Structure

Affiliates may earn the following flat commission on each eligible product sold through a properly attributed order:

Eligible productCommission per eligible item
Pillow$5.00
Blanket$5.00
Canvas$7.00
Framed poster$7.00
Framed canvas$10.00

Commission is calculated per eligible item, not as a percentage of the order.

For example, if a qualifying customer purchases one eligible pillow and one eligible framed canvas, the potential commission is $15.00, subject to validation of the order and all other provisions of these Terms.

No commission is earned on:

  • Taxes;

  • Shipping or delivery charges;

  • Tips, donations, or other non-product charges;

  • Gift-card purchases;

  • Returned, refunded, cancelled, disputed, or charged-back products;

  • Fraudulent or unauthorized transactions;

  • Self-referrals;

  • Test orders;

  • Orders placed in violation of these Terms;

  • Products excluded from the Program;

  • Free products or products reduced to a zero-dollar product subtotal; or

  • Any other amount not designated as commissionable in the affiliate dashboard.

If only part of an order is returned, cancelled, refunded, or charged back, the commission associated with that product may be cancelled or deducted.

Called & Marked Co. may introduce, discontinue, rename, repackage, or reclassify products. If a new or revised product is not clearly covered by the commission table, its commission will be the amount displayed in the affiliate dashboard or otherwise communicated in writing.

7. Discounts and the Welcome Offer

Called & Marked Co. may offer customers a 10% first-order welcome discount or other promotional discounts.

A customer’s use of a general welcome, email-signup, seasonal, or promotional code does not independently identify or credit an Affiliate. To receive attribution, the customer must use the Affiliate’s properly tracked Affiliate Link or an authorized Affiliate Coupon recognized by the Program.

If a customer uses an Affiliate Link and an approved discount code, the Affiliate may still receive the applicable flat commission if:

  1. The order is successfully attributed to the Affiliate;

  2. The discount is permitted for that order;

  3. The order and products otherwise qualify for commission; and

  4. The order is successfully completed and is not later refunded, cancelled, disputed, or charged back.

Discounts cannot be combined unless the checkout system and the terms of the applicable promotion expressly permit combination.

Affiliates may not promise that a discount will apply, advertise an expired discount, or represent that an Affiliate Coupon offers the lowest available price unless Called & Marked Co. has expressly authorized that statement.

8. Order Validation

Commissions initially appearing in the affiliate dashboard may be pending and are not guaranteed.

We may review each referral and withhold approval while determining whether the order:

  • Was successfully paid;

  • Was properly attributed;

  • Was placed by a legitimate customer;

  • Has passed the applicable cancellation, return, refund, and chargeback period; and

  • Complies with these Terms.

Transactions resulting in a cancellation, refund, return, payment dispute, chargeback, suspected fraud, duplicate attribution, or violation of these Terms will not be paid.

If a commission was paid before an order became ineligible, we may deduct the amount from future commissions or request repayment.

9. Payment Schedule and Minimum Payout

Eligible approved commissions will be processed monthly, subject to a $25 minimum payout threshold.

If your approved commission balance is less than $25 at the time payments are processed, the balance will roll forward and remain in your account until your approved balance reaches at least $25.

Payment timing may be affected by order validation, return periods, weekends, holidays, payment-provider processing times, missing payment details, tax-document requirements, suspected Program violations, or technical issues.

Payments will be issued using a payment method supported by the Program and selected or approved by Called & Marked Co. You are responsible for providing complete and accurate payment information.

Affiliates are responsible for transaction fees, currency-conversion fees, banking fees, or other charges imposed by their chosen payment provider unless Called & Marked Co. states otherwise.

If your participation ends, any final legitimate and approved commission balance will be processed during the next practicable payment cycle after all relevant orders have been validated, even if the final approved balance is below $25. No payment will be made for fraudulent, cancelled, refunded, disputed, or otherwise ineligible commissions.

10. Taxes

Affiliates are solely responsible for reporting and paying all federal, state, local, and international taxes arising from payments received through the Program.

Called & Marked Co. does not provide tax, accounting, or legal advice. We may require tax forms, identity verification, or other legally required documentation before issuing payment.

Payment may be withheld until requested documentation has been properly completed and received.

11. Required Affiliate Disclosures

Whenever you promote Called & Marked Co., share an Affiliate Link or Affiliate Coupon, or endorse one of our products, you must clearly and conspicuously disclose your material relationship with Called & Marked Co.

An acceptable disclosure may state:

“I may earn a commission if you purchase through this link.”

Other disclosures may be acceptable if they clearly communicate that you may receive compensation from purchases.

The disclosure must:

  • Appear close to the endorsement, Affiliate Link, or Affiliate Coupon;

  • Be easy for an ordinary consumer to notice and understand;

  • Appear before or with the Affiliate Link when reasonably possible;

  • Not be hidden among hashtags, links, or lengthy text;

  • Not require the consumer to click “more” to discover it;

  • Be included in the content itself when required;

  • Be visible long enough to be read in image-based or temporary content; and

  • Comply with applicable Federal Trade Commission requirements and platform rules.

For video endorsements, the disclosure should appear in the video and not solely in the description. When appropriate, the disclosure should be both visible on screen and spoken aloud.

Terms such as “affiliate link,” “ambassador,” “collab,” “partner,” “spon,” “thanks,” or similar wording may be insufficient when they do not clearly explain that you may receive compensation.

The Affiliate is responsible for understanding and complying with all applicable endorsement, advertising, consumer-protection, privacy, email-marketing, and disclosure laws.

12. Honest Endorsements and Advertising Claims

All statements about Called & Marked Co. and its products must be truthful, accurate, and not misleading.

You may not:

  • Claim to have used a product you have not used;

  • Misrepresent your personal experience;

  • Make false or unsubstantiated claims;

  • Guarantee customer satisfaction, delivery dates, product performance, results, or outcomes;

  • Misrepresent product materials, dimensions, customization options, pricing, availability, discounts, return rights, or shipping times;

  • Copy or fabricate customer testimonials or reviews;

  • Encourage or publish fake reviews;

  • Imply that an independent review is unbiased without disclosing your affiliate relationship;

  • Make medical, therapeutic, safety, or other specialized claims that Called & Marked Co. has not expressly authorized;

  • Advertise a product or promotion after being notified that it has expired, sold out, or been discontinued; or

  • Make a statement that conflicts with the current information on the Called & Marked Co. website.

If we notify you that promotional content is inaccurate, noncompliant, outdated, unauthorized, or potentially harmful, you must promptly correct or remove it.

13. Permitted Promotional Methods

Subject to these Terms, Affiliates may promote Called & Marked Co. through approved channels, including:

  • Websites and blogs;

  • Social-media posts and videos;

  • Email newsletters sent to recipients who lawfully agreed to receive them;

  • Podcasts;

  • Printed promotional materials;

  • Product demonstrations;

  • Approved in-person events; and

  • Other channels approved by Called & Marked Co.

Affiliates must comply with the advertising, sponsorship, promotional, intellectual-property, and community rules of each platform used.

14. Prohibited Promotional Methods

  1. Send unsolicited commercial email, text messages, direct messages, or other spam;

  2. Purchase, rent, scrape, or unlawfully obtain contact lists;

  3. Use deceptive pop-ups, forced clicks, cookie stuffing, adware, spyware, toolbars, automatic redirects, or other methods that place or activate tracking without a genuine customer action;

  16. Interfere with another Affiliate’s referrals or tracking;

15. Self-Referrals and Related-Party Orders

Affiliates may not earn commission on their own purchases.

A self-referral includes an order placed:

  • Using the Affiliate’s payment method;

  • For the Affiliate’s primary personal or business use;

  • Using information substantially associated with the Affiliate;

  • By another person acting primarily to help the Affiliate earn commission; or

Genuine purchases by friends, relatives, coworkers, or followers may qualify when they independently choose to purchase for their own use and the transaction is otherwise legitimate.

We reserve the right to review related-party transactions and determine eligibility based on the surrounding circumstances.

hello@calledandmarkedco.com
